question: How many daily average PLA incursions into Taiwan's ADIZ will occur for the week of October 19-25, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Anchor: MND logged 1,200 ADIZ entries Jan 1-Aug 9 2026 (~5.4/day), less than half of 2025's pace, after the Xi-Trump summit. Recent weekly ADIZ daily averages: ~11.6 (Sep 14-20), 3.0 (Sep 21-27), 3.9 (Sep 28-Oct 4), 4.9 (Oct 5-11). This week so far: Oct 13 report 4 aircraft, Oct 14 report 9; a joint readiness patrol on Oct 14 had 11 aircraft cross the median line. Live-fire drills end Oct 17, before the window. Joint readiness patrols (1-2 per week, ~13-16 ADIZ entries each) drive upside. No exercise is known to be scheduled for Oct 19-25. Escape tails: 2026 had a 7-day zero-aircraft pause (below 0.93) and large named exercises (above 20). Unknown: whether the resolution sheet counts ADIZ entries or all detected aircraft; I assumed ADIZ entries and widened the upper tail. Markets: none found on Polymarket, Manifold or Kalshi for this; Polymarket invasion/clash markets are not comparable.
sources: https://www.janes.com/defence-intelligence-insights/defence-news/air/pla-helicopters-enter-taiwans-adiz-for-the-first-time (search snippet of Taiwan Security Monitor Oct 5-11 weekly)

- Resolution: daily average of PLA incursions (aircraft entering ADIZ per MND daily reports) for Oct 19-25 2026, dates as shown in MND reports (Taiwan time; each report covers 06:00 the previous day to 06:00 that day). The base-rate Google Sheet couldn't be fetched (401). It is unclear whether 'incursions' means ADIZ entries or all aircraft detected; all detected runs about 1.6x ADIZ entries (e.g. Oct 5-11: 56 detected vs 34 ADIZ).
- Event window: Oct 19 -> Oct 25 2026 (MND report dates); as of 2026-10-14 0% elapsed.
- Status quo: the 2026 regime is low-tempo air activity. Jan 1-Aug 9 2026: 1,200 ADIZ entries (~5.4/day) vs 2,501 in the same window of 2025 (globalmilitary.net, via search). H1 2026 fighter detections 1,334, a 3-year low (SCMP). Analysts attribute the drop to the Xi-Trump summit.
- Weekly ADIZ totals (Taiwan Security Monitor, via search): Sep 14-20 about 81 (~11.6/day; 99 aircraft detected); Sep 21-27 21 (3.0/day); Sep 28-Oct 4 27 (3.9/day); Oct 5-11 34 (4.9/day, joint readiness patrols on Oct 6 and Oct 9).
- Single days: Sep 16: 20 detected, 15 in ADIZ. Sep 30: 23 detected, 16 in ADIZ (joint readiness patrol). Oct 10 report: 21 detected, 13 crossed median/entered.
- Monthly: September 255 aircraft detected, August 173 (TSM). March 2026 171 detected, lowest monthly figure since Aug 2022 (Threads dataviz).
- Early 2026 had a pause of 7+ straight days with no PLA aircraft detected (TSM on X), so near-zero weeks happen.
- Oct 13 report (CNA/UDN): 4 aircraft, 6 PLAN ships. Oct 14 report: 9 aircraft, all crossed the median line. Oct 14 midday: joint readiness patrol, 13 aircraft, 11 crossed the median line (will count in the Oct 15 report).
- PLA live-fire/artillery drills in 5 sea areas Oct 12-17 (Epoch Times). The MND minister assessed them as coastal artillery training; they end before the window. Context: Lai's National Day speech; US anti-ship missiles on Yonaguni.
- Searched without finding: any PLA exercise announced for Oct 19-25; the base-rate sheet contents; prediction markets on ADIZ counts (none on Polymarket, Manifold or Kalshi).
- Upside drivers: 1-2 joint readiness patrols per week (~11-16 ADIZ each); a reaction to US-Taiwan events; a large named exercise (could push the weekly average above 20). Downside: the post-summit diplomatic lull; quiet weeks of ~3/day.
